items.t: Front lower ball joint wear (recall 05V225)
items.job: Replace both front lower ball joints and align
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall for affected trucks. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Frame rust in salt-belt states
items.job: Cut out rusted frame sections and weld in repair plates
items.note: Price varies widely with how much rust is found. A full frame swap costs much more.

items.t: Fuel pulsation damper leak (recall 03V146)
items.job: Replace fuel pulsation damper
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Cracked dashboard
items.job: Replace instrument panel top pad
items.note: Toyota coverage for this has expired. A molded dash cover is a cheap alternative.

items.t: Floor mat can trap the gas pedal (recall 11V113)
items.job: Modify gas pedal and secure floor mat
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may fire without a crash (recall 16V065)
items.job: Replace airbag sensor or control unit
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Secondary air injection pump or valve failure
items.job: Replace secondary air pump and air switching valves
items.note: Sometimes only the pump or one valve is needed. Some trucks had extended Toyota coverage, now likely expired.

items.t: Hydraulic suspension leaks (KDSS or X-REAS)
items.job: Replace leaking KDSS accumulator or cylinder
items.note: X-REAS shocks are replaced as a set and cost more. Some owners switch to standard shocks.

items.t: Harsh low-speed shifts
items.job: Reprogram engine and transmission computer
items.note: If a worn torque converter is found, expect much more.

items.t: Door lock actuator failures
items.job: Replace door lock actuator
items.note: Price is per door.

items.t: Infotainment screen freezes or reboots
items.job: Replace touchscreen digitizer or update software
items.note: If the radio unit itself has failed, expect much more.

items.t: Fuel pump may fail and stall the engine (recall 20V012)
items.job: Replace fuel pump
items.note: Covered by the Denso fuel pump recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Grille or hood overlay can come loose (recall 17V763)
items.job: Secure or replace hood and grille trim
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Fuel pump may fail and stall the engine (recall 20V682)
items.job: Replace fuel pump
items.note: Covered by the Denso fuel pump recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Loose steering or suspension bolts (recall 19V670)
items.job: Inspect and tighten steering and suspension bolts
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Gauge cluster may not show speed or warnings (recall 25V595)
items.job: Update instrument cluster software
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Rough or clunky shifts from the 8-speed automatic
items.job: Update transmission software and check fluid
items.note: Newer trucks should be covered by Toyota warranty. Ask the dealer about updates.

items.t: Head gasket failure on the early 4.0L V6
items.job: Replace head gaskets and resurface cylinder heads
items.note: Heads are usually machined at the same time. Confirm the diagnosis with a cooling system pressure test first.

items.t: Front brake calipers stick and drag
items.job: Replace front brake caliper, pads and rotor

items.t: Add-on seat heaters can short and burn the seat
items.job: Disconnect accessory seat heater and inspect wiring
items.note: Free under recall 16V-396 or 14V-743, with a refund for the accessory. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Accessory exhaust tip can burn people behind the truck
items.job: Replace dealer-installed exhaust tip
items.note: Free under recall 15V-515 or 16V-577. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor may be out of calibration
items.job: Test and recalibrate occupant sensing system
items.note: Free under recall 13V-014. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Add-on remote starter can knock out ABS and stability control
items.job: Remove or replace non-original remote starter
items.note: Free under recall 12V-120. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Accessory hood scoop can come loose
items.job: Mechanically fasten accessory hood scoop
items.note: Free under recall 17V-425. Check the VIN first.

items.t: High beam can stop working after fog lights are fitted
items.job: Install updated headlight wiring harness
items.note: Free under recall 21V-963. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Load capacity label may show the wrong weight
items.job: Install corrected load capacity label
items.note: Free under recalls 22V-480, 23V-680, 24V-548 and 26V-282. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Radiator can let coolant into the transmission fluid
items.job: Replace radiator and flush transmission cooler lines
items.note: If the fluid already looks milky, budget separately for transmission repair or replacement.
